meta.description: Unlimited caregivers, patients and stored prescriptions for the Dose Care medication-reminder app. Pay with bKash.

landing.label: Dose Care Premium
landing.title: Care for everyone you love, without limits.
landing.subtitle: Dose Care keeps medication schedules on track. Premium removes the caps on caregivers, patients and stored prescriptions — so the whole family can help.
landing.payWithBkash: Pay with bKash · verified within 24 hours
landing.step1Body: Use the same Google account you use in the Dose Care app so we know who is paying.
landing.step2Body: Send the amount from your bKash app and copy the Transaction ID.
landing.step3Body: Paste it here. We verify it within 24 hours and Premium turns on in the app automatically.
landing.pricingNote: Prices in Bangladeshi Taka. USD shown for reference only.
landing.faq1Q: Do I need to do anything in the app?
landing.faq1A: No. The app checks your plan every time it opens. Once your payment is verified, Premium is simply there — and any paused caregivers come back.
landing.faq2Q: What if I pay while I'm already Premium?
landing.faq2A: The new period is added on top of your current end date. Nothing is lost.
landing.faq3A: Nothing is deleted. Caregivers and patients beyond the free limit are paused until you renew.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the same Google account you use in the Dose Care app.
signIn.note: Signing in only tells us which Dose Care account to upgrade. We never post anything or read your data.

pay.title: Get Premium
pay.subtitle: Pay manually with bKash, then submit the Transaction ID.
pay.instructionsIntro: Open your bKash app and follow these steps:
pay.instr4: Reference: {reference} — this helps us match your payment.
pay.instr5: Confirm with your PIN, then copy the Transaction ID (TrxID) from the confirmation screen or SMS.
pay.trxIdHint: 10 characters, letters and numbers. We'll capitalise it for you.
pay.senderHint: Helps us find the payment faster.
pay.successTitle: Thanks! We've received your Transaction ID.
pay.successBody: We'll verify {trxId} within 24 hours. Premium turns on in the app automatically — no need to do anything else.
pay.successAccount: Track it on your account page
pay.errTrxInvalid: That doesn't look like a bKash Transaction ID. It should be 10 letters and numbers.
pay.errSenderInvalid: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX) or leave it empty.
pay.errDuplicate: This Transaction ID has already been submitted. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
pay.errTooMany: You already have 5 submissions waiting for review. Please wait for those before adding another.
pay.errPriceUnset: Payments aren't open yet. Please check back soon.
pay.errUnauthenticated: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
pay.errUnknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
pay.pendingNotice: You have {count, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}} waiting for review.
pay.alreadyPremium: You're on Premium until {date}. Paying now adds a new period on top.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains what the Dose Care Premium website collects and why.
legal.privacyBody: TODO: policy text. Draft: We store your Google name, email and avatar to identify your Dose Care account; the bKash Transaction IDs and optional sender numbers you submit, to verify payments; and your plan status. We do not sell data. Contact {email} to request deletion.
legal.termsIntro: The rules for using Dose Care Premium.
legal.termsBody: TODO: policy text. Draft: Premium is a subscription to extra features in the Dose Care app, activated after manual verification of a bKash payment. Periods are added to the current end date. Prices may change; the price shown at the time of payment applies.
legal.refundIntro: How refunds work for bKash payments.
legal.refundBody: TODO: policy text. Draft: Payments that cannot be matched to a bKash transaction are rejected and not charged. Verified subscriptions are non-refundable except where required by law. Contact {email} within 7 days of payment for help.
